note: Every mechanical check this track's PREREGISTRATION.md promises. `check_promises.py` fails when a promise whose phase has run has no implementing check, and fails when a promise is deleted rather than amended. Promises are AMENDED in place, never deleted: an amended promise keeps its id and records what changed.
